name: do-flow
example-prompts: Execute the do-flow graph for gtd-tool domain.
Summarize what we have accomplished so far and what my immediate next step is using a short, engaging, epic fantasy narrative tone in spanish.

instructions: Execute this job only if a domain name is not provided in order to present initiative options to the user for selection.
Use global as the domain and create-initiative as the source-job-identifier.
After presenting the initiative options, halt execution and ask the user to choose an initiative.
Execute this job in Latest mode.
Execute this job using the task list content and task file path resolved by the preceding step.
Since the task list content is already loaded into context from the add-tasks dump, do NOT read the task file again; use the task file path exclusively for editing and updating task states in-place.
